ranked for beginner to intermediate lifters:
small jumps, a setup you can repeat, safe to train alone.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#5 chin-ups
great for biceps too, but hard to add load in small steps.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#4 barbell curl
swing creeps in as it gets heavy, so sessions stop comparing.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#3 dumbbell hammer curl
simple and quick. dumbbell jumps are big, so add reps first.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#2 cable curl
small pin jumps and steady tension. stacks vary, so stay on one.

bonus tip: track every set, not just the heaviest one.

#1 machine preacher curl
fixed path, no swing, small jumps. the easiest to repeat and beat.
